quests.Name: Lost Goat
quests.Description: Old Tully's goat wandered off again. Last seen by the south fields. He is too old to go looking himself.

quests.Name: Strayed Cattle
quests.Description: Two of the herd broke the fence in the night. Whoever brings them back gets what I can spare.

quests.Name: Rat Problem
quests.Description: The cellar is crawling with them. They have got into the good barrels.

quests.Name: Crows in the Barley
quests.Description: Every morning there are more. Bring a sling if you have one.

quests.Name: A Letter for My Sister
quests.Description: She is in the next village and I cannot leave the mill. It is not far.

quests.Name: Herbal Help
quests.Description: My boy has the fever and the herbs I need do not grow near here.

quests.Name: Firewood Before Winter
quests.Description: The stack is short and my back is not what it was. Cut what you can.

quests.Name: The Well Is Fouled
quests.Description: Something dead went down it. Somebody has to go down after it.

quests.Name: Missing Parcel
quests.Description: It fell off the cart somewhere on the north road. It matters to me more than it looks.

quests.Name: Help with the Harvest
quests.Description: Three days of work, honest pay, and my wife feeds whoever shows up.

quests.Name: Tully's Boy Is Missing
quests.Description: He was told to stay in sight of the house. He never does.

quests.Name: Broken Cart Axle
quests.Description: Stuck half a day out on the east track. Bring timber and a strong arm.

quests.Name: A Debt Unpaid
quests.Description: He is not a bad man, only forgetful. Remind him. Gently.

quests.Name: Salt for the Curing
quests.Description: The season turns next week and without salt the whole hog is wasted.

quests.Name: Stone for the Wall
quests.Description: The north wall came down in the rain. I need cut stone and no one is selling.

quests.Name: Ale for the Wake
quests.Description: My father is buried tomorrow. The tavern is dry. Do not let me bury him dry.

quests.Name: Escort Needed
quests.Description: Caravan departs at dawn, two guards short. Payment on arrival, not before.

quests.Name: Hunt the Wolf
quests.Description: A wolf has taken four head of livestock near the old mill. The Guild pays on proof.

quests.Name: Recover Stolen Goods
quests.Description: Three crates taken off the northern road. Contents listed with the clerk.

quests.Name: Guard the Shipment
quests.Description: Overnight watch on a bonded cargo. No questions about the cargo.

quests.Name: Clear the Road
quests.Description: The pass has been closed nine days. Reopen it. The Guild is losing money.

quests.Name: Collect a Debt
quests.Description: The sum is listed. The method is yours. Do not embarrass the house.

quests.Name: Catch the Runaway
quests.Description: An apprentice broke his indenture. Bring him back, unharmed, and the matter closes.

quests.Name: Check the Border Stones
quests.Description: Someone has been moving them. Walk the line and report what you find.

quests.Name: A Master's Apprentice
quests.Description: The Guild seeks a boy with hands worth training. Find one and vouch for him.

quests.Name: Haul the Ore
quests.Description: Eight loads down from the cut, before the weather turns.

quests.Name: The Boar in the Orchard
quests.Description: It has ruined two seasons of grafting. The orchard master is beyond patience.

quests.Name: Buy at the Source
quests.Description: Travel, purchase at the listed price, return. Any saving is yours to keep.

quests.Name: Poachers on the Estate
quests.Description: Snares found in the lord's wood. He wants names, not bodies.

quests.Name: The Ferry Is Out
quests.Description: No crossing for a week and the goods are spoiling. Sort it out.

quests.Name: The Hideout
quests.Description: A bandit camp above the treeline. Numbers unknown. The steward wants it gone before the harvest fair.

quests.Name: Silence at the Cut
quests.Description: Three weeks without word from the northern shaft. Nobody came down for the change of shift. The Lord wants to know.

quests.Name: The Missing Patrol
quests.Description: Six men, a routine circuit, and no one returned. Follow their route.

quests.Name: A Matter Between Houses
quests.Description: Two families, one boundary, and forty years of grievance. Settle it without blood if you can.

quests.Name: Supply the Garrison
quests.Description: Full provision for eighty men, delivered inside a fortnight. Shortfall will be noted.

quests.Name: Follow the Trail
quests.Description: Someone left Whitmarch and did not arrive. The family is paying. The steward is asking.

quests.Name: Empty the Village
quests.Description: The river is rising and they will not go. Persuade them. All of them.

quests.Name: The Saboteur
quests.Description: Four fires in six weeks, none of them accidents. The Guild wants the hand behind it.

quests.Name: The Wolves of Dunmoor
quests.Description: Not a wolf. A pack, and they have stopped being afraid of fire.

quests.Name: Broker the Crossing
quests.Description: Sahenmar wants the toll lowered. Karnhold wants it raised. Someone must go and say so.

quests.Name: By the Steward's Hand
quests.Description: Under seal. The bearer is charged with the settlement of the Berrowfield accounts. Obstruction will be reported.

quests.Name: The Rebellion at Grimwater
quests.Description: Three villages have refused the levy. The Crown requires the matter closed. The method is left to the bearer.

quests.Name: Terms with the Marcher Lord
quests.Description: The bearer is empowered to negotiate on behalf of the Crown. The bearer is not empowered to concede the river.

quests.Name: The Beast of the Old Wood
quests.Description: It has taken eleven. Descriptions do not agree. The Crown will pay for the head, whatever it turns out to be.

quests.Name: Open the Eastern Road
quests.Description: A route from Qasran to the coast, surveyed, cleared and held. The Crown will fund what is necessary.

quests.Name: The Concord Envoy
quests.Description: Escort and protect the party to the border meeting. Their safety is the Crown's honour.

quests.Name: The Iron Summons
quests.Description: Ashgard calls. Come armed, come sober, and come alone. What is asked will not be written down.

quests.Name: The White Seal
quests.Description: Whitmarch has need of a hand that is not attached to a house. Discretion is the whole of the payment, and the reward.

quests.Name: The Gilded Request
quests.Description: Evoynir asks — and Evoynir does not often ask. Come to the Palm Court. Wear something better than that.
